# expr

Evaluate integer, string and basic-regex expressions through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/expr 7 + 5

moonx cli/expr abc : 'a\(.*\)'
```

Pass operators and operands as separate arguments. Output the result; status distinguishes a nonzero/nonempty result, a zero/empty result and errors.

## Notes

- Uses the documented C-byte expression grammar, not a general-purpose language. Quote operators that the invoking shell would interpret.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
